reports.name: Palinurus elephas
reports.shape: Continuous spined carapace, separate visible eye ends, curved dentate supraorbital horns, narrow unarmed antennular plate, shorter antennules, six overlapping grooved abdominal plates with selected paired pale spots, five-part tail fan and ten articulated non-chelate walking limbs replace the oval/rod draft.
reports.surface: Red-brown original numerical cuticle with a subdued pale flank, irregularly spaced seated spines, longitudinal leg streaks, paired spots on somites2–5 and a single posterior spot6. Tapered strong antennae and fine fan-ray cues remain on the same model through all actions.
reports.remaining: Carapace/head proportions, fine spine coordinates and density, segment grooves, pleural contours, antennal joints, eye microanatomy, maxillipeds and optical properties remain simplified and unmeasured. Ten supported limbs and a mild local tail flex are educational articulation studies, not observed/fitted species kinematics. Female-specific final-leg chelation, sex-modified pleopods, complete mouthparts, internal organs and fluid/feeding functions are not reconstructed. The model is still partly stylized and does not represent every posture, stage or phenotype.

reports.name: Panulirus versicolor
reports.shape: A separately proportioned spiny carapace, four separated principal antennular-plate spines, longer antennules, strong tapered second antennae, smooth six-somite banded abdomen with shallow selected pubescent-area cues on somites2/3, five-part fan and ten articulated non-chelate limbs replace the generic draft.
reports.surface: An original irregular blue-green and pale cuticle mosaic, pale abdominal bands with dark margins, longitudinal pale/dark leg stripes, selected pink basal antennae with pale flagella, and original fan-ray cues follow the retained OpenCage photograph and scoped FAO descriptions.
reports.remaining: Exact body ratios, principal/secondary spine positions, pubescent fields and setae, fan/pleopod membranes, antennal articulation and mouthparts remain approximate. Original pigment and roughness are not measured cuticle optics or a scan. Source-photo stage/sex are not independently redetermined. Female P5 chelation, internal anatomy, true sensory processing, stridulation, food handling/ingestion and hydrodynamic escape are absent. The model remains partly stylized, with authored unmeasured support and partial tail articulation rather than validated biological biomechanics.

limits: Original qualitative educational reconstruction; proportions, cuticle optics, natural timing, joint limits, forces, feeding, sensing and physiology remain unmeasured. No independent specialist validation or accuracy percentage. Software support checks are not empirical biological validation.
